dispute_ticket.description: My app estimated 22 km. The driver took some other way and the meter ended at 31 km. He never asked. I want the difference refunded.
dispute_ticket.driver_statement: Kallang Paya Lebar Expressway was crawling, so I went round it. Any driver would have done the same.
